nodes.label: Host-Aware URL Surfaces (Multi-Tenant)
nodes.summary: In a Next.js multi-tenant storefront serving N hostnames, ALL URL-emitting artifacts must branch on the request's `host` header: verification meta tags, sitemap URLs, robots.txt sitemap directive, canonical links, og:url, Schema.org @id/url, and email footer CTAs. Audit pattern: grep for `getSiteUrl(` — every hit is a candidate for a host-aware override. FWB commits fc91137 + a7af7d5. Generalises from FWB day after wadyaljuz.com went live.

nodes.label: Host-Aware GSC Verification Meta Tag
nodes.summary: When a multi-tenant platform serves both platform and merchant hostnames, emitting both GSC verification tokens on the same page causes GSC to verify against the FIRST tag — the wrong owner on a custom domain — and leaks the hosting relationship. Fix: check `host` header against `store.domain`; if custom domain, emit only `store.googleSiteVerification`; otherwise emit platform token (+ merchant token if set). FWB commit fc91137, `apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx generateMetadata`.

nodes.label: Per-Tenant Sitemap Fan-Out
nodes.summary: A single `app/sitemap.ts` route must detect whether the request host matches a known custom domain (resolve via `/public/store/resolve` with `x-store-domain` header). If yes: emit only that store's URLs rooted at `https://<host>`. If no: emit the master sitemap covering all stores under platform slugs. Without this, submitting the custom-domain sitemap to GSC tells Google to index platform URLs the merchant doesn't own. FWB commit a7af7d5.

nodes.label: Host-Aware robots.txt Sitemap Directive
nodes.summary: The `sitemap:` line in robots.txt must point at the same-host sitemap, not the platform sitemap. Derive base URL from the request `host` header in `apps/web/src/app/robots.ts`: `const base = host ? \`https://\${host}\` : getSiteUrl()`. Ensures `https://wadyaljuz.com/robots.txt` says `Sitemap: https://wadyaljuz.com/sitemap.xml`. FWB commit a7af7d5.

nodes.label: getSiteUrl() Audit Pattern for Host-Aware Overrides
nodes.summary: Every call to `getSiteUrl(` in a multi-tenant Next.js app is a candidate for needing a host-aware override when the request is for a tenant on a custom domain. Grep for `getSiteUrl(` across the app and evaluate each hit: does this code path run in a request context where the host could be a custom tenant domain? If yes, replace with a host-header-derived base URL. Applied after FWB's custom-domain launch 2026-05-14.
